fields.prompt_body:
Tuned procedure — the librarian tuning overlay sharpens the default, never replaces it:

1. Preload `amico-vault` and `amico-schema-check`; read the mount stack from disk, never from the brief's summary.
2. Classify from the folder responsibility table; a claim with a local-only mechanism is TWO notes, authored up front.
3. Validate the frontmatter before returning the filing receipt; a note that fails validation is fixed, not filed as-is.
fields.model_routing: the heavy reasoning class for curation casts that span campaigns; the standard class for single-note filing — the tuned default splits by cast weight, not by habit.
fields.iteration_budget: two curation passes and one validation pass per note cluster; a third pass needs the director's say-so named in the brief.
fields.example_brief: File the note, tuned: Vault: <path> (mount stack from disk). Route per the vault skill; split local-only mechanisms into linked pairs. Schema-check every note; return one receipt per note.
